name: Tubal Ligation
overview: Scripture reveals that God blesses humanity with the command to be fruitful and multiply, emphasizing the sanctity and purpose of procreation as part of His design for mankind (Genesis 1:28). Children are described as a heritage and reward from the Lord, underscoring the value and blessing of offspring (Psalms 127:3). Furthermore, God’s intention for marriage includes the pursuit of a godly seed, highlighting the spiritual significance of family and the responsibility husbands have toward their wives in this covenant relationship (Malachi 2:15). These passages collectively affirm the divine purpose and blessing of bearing children within the marriage covenant.
